title: Inspect a fitted two-state model
description: You read the fitted initial probabilities, transitions, and Gaussian parameters.

steps.description: You request two hidden states and fit the standardized features Xs. The call supplies an iteration limit, convergence tolerance, and random generator.
You print the initial state probabilities pi and transition matrix A. The recorded pi is [0., 1.].

steps.question: Which is larger in each recorded transition row: staying in the same state or switching?
steps.answer: Staying is larger in both rows. The diagonal entries are 0.9192 and 0.9885.

steps.description: You print one mean and variance for each feature in each state. The output contains two rows of six values in both arrays.
